## OQ-170 custody proposal (summary)

Kernel-held Ed25519 key via `ring::signature` — an explicit ADR-0359 D2 scope
extension, named in the brief. The kernel process owns custody; key material
never enters `hh-ledger` — the existing `AuditSigner`/`AuditKeyResolver` seams
stay, `signer_key_ids` get populated. File-backed per-installation storage at
`0600`; provisioning is per installation via the `CredentialBroker::kernel_use`
path (`KernelPurpose::LedgerSigning`); rotation is a co-signed `rotation`
checkpoint (old key signs the successor's enrollment) with the operator as the
ratifying authority. Three alternatives (HSM/KMS custody, per-run ephemeral
keys, external signer service) recorded with trade-offs. Implementation is
R4.15e's — this ticket proposes only.
